added: AVIF export and a live before/after comparison slider in Images.
PDF page-range extraction, and merging pages into an already-open document.
Update notifications show each release's notes in your own language.
changed: Images processes multiple files as an independent queue, with per-file progress, instead of one at a time.
Images can resize on export and set a background color for transparent-to-opaque conversions.
fixed: PDF handles malformed and hostile documents more safely; large documents merge and extract reliably.
